Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 12 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat) and Super Typhoon NANDO
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 23 September 2025(Tuesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Nueva Ecija, Quezon, Bulacan, Rizal, Metro Manila, Cavite, Laguna and Batangas within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Tarlac(Capas, Bamban, Concepcion) and Pampanga(Floridablanca, Santa Rita, Guagua, Lubao, Sasmuan, Bacolor, San Fernando, Minalin, Macabebe, Masantol, Angeles, Mabalacat, Porac) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
